people.name: Cornelius
people.line: Centurion, first Gentile convert to Christianity

translations.web: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him, “Cornelius!”
translations.bsb: One day at about the ninth hour, he had a clear vision of an angel of God who came to him and said, “Cornelius!”
translations.kjv: He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius.
translations.asv: He saw in a vision openly, as it were about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of God coming in unto him, and saying to him, Cornelius.
